name: axon
description: Semantic computer use for Windows and macOS. Reads apps through the accessibility tree instead of screenshots, so it targets exactly, survives display scaling, and costs ~23x fewer tokens. Knows the difference between your input and its own, so you can keep working on the same desktop while it works. WARNING: controls your real computer - read the README.

blocked_apps.title: Additional blocked apps
blocked_apps.description: Comma-separated process names Axon must never read or drive, on top of its built-in blocklist. Example: myvault,internal-admin

coexist_mode.title: Coexistence mode
coexist_mode.description: share = wait for a gap in your typing before using the cursor (recommended). yield = refuse while you are active. take = interrupt you.

user_idle_ms.title: Idle threshold (ms)
user_idle_ms.description: How long you must be quiet before Axon considers the machine free.
